opening.argument: The speaker presents BitConnect as legitimate while claiming a $6,000 investment generated $800 in approximately six days. That claimed return is paired with a demonstrated route for converting the money to cash and sending it to a bank account, alongside an account page showing investment, earnings, and transfer functions. The presentation also directs viewers to a supplied BitConnect referral URL and offers 3% back on a first investment to people who register through the link. The speaker further asks them to send the amount they invested, while the page includes an “INVEST NOW” prompt. Taken together, these are direct investment and lending-return solicitations supported by claimed earnings, transaction demonstrations, and referral incentives.

citations.quote: I made an investment of $6,000, and it was like the six days. In those six days I have generated $800 dollars
I will show you how I convert this money to cash and after that, I will send it to my bank account
all the people who register below me, I´ll give them the 3% back of their first investment
